lesson.title: Wonder and Innovation
lesson.topic: Explore how sustained wonder fuels creative problem-solving and innovation.
lesson.steelman: How can fostering a mindset of perpetual curiosity enhance one's capacity for groundbreaking inventions?
lesson.example: Thomas Edison’s relentless questioning led to numerous technological advancements, including the practical light bulb.

rationale: Encourages learners to connect wonder with real-world impacts in technology and science.
